aboutHeading: 10 Years of Gardening Excellence in Keilor East
aboutText: For over a decade, Tuscany Gardens has been the trusted choice for gardening and landscaping across Keilor East and Melbourne's western suburbs. We specialise in custom garden design, construction, and ongoing maintenance, tailoring every service to suit your property and our local seasonal conditions. Our skilled team uses the latest tools and materials to deliver reliable, quality workmanship, ensuring your garden remains healthy, functional, and visually appealing all year round.
servicesHeading: Our Full Range of Gardening Services
servicesText: Tuscany Gardens offers a complete suite of gardening services, from new garden designs and irrigation installations to regular maintenance and synthetic turf. We manage every aspect of your outdoor space, providing end-to-end service with a guarantee on all workmanship.

services.title: Garden Design & Construction
services.desc: We create and build custom garden spaces, from initial concept to complete, beautiful construction.

services.title: Irrigation & Watering Solutions
services.desc: Professional installation and repairs for efficient irrigation systems tailored to your garden's needs.

services.title: Lawn Care & Synthetic Turf
services.desc: Expert lawn maintenance, aeration, and high-quality synthetic or natural turf installations.

services.title: Hedging, Pruning & Tree Care
services.desc: Skilled shaping, pruning, and health management for hedges, shrubs, and trees of all sizes.

services.title: Garden Clean-Ups & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular or one-off garden clean-ups, mulching, weeding, and general upkeep to keep your space pristine.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Health
services.desc: We ensure your garden thrives year-round with services adapted to Melbourne's unique seasonal conditions.
